seraphine_vale.name: Seraphine Vale
seraphine_vale.role: Communion Leader / Voice of the Hollow Saint (campaign BBEG)
seraphine_vale.notes: Mechanical stats/escalation tracked separately in the BBEG tracker (see manifest.bbeg + escalation_stages.json). This entry is for social/dialogue state only -- disposition here reflects her attitude toward the party, not her power level.

elian_thorn.name: Elian Thorn
known_facts: Genuinely believes he is helping people and hasn't fully reckoned with what the miracles cost.
Performed the healing that first drew the party's attention to Windshear Hollow.
elian_thorn.notes: Sincere-believer NPC. Good vehicle for the 'good person becomes a monster' theme in miniature -- he's an early, gentler version of Seraphine's journey.

mira_hallow.name: Mira Hallow
mira_hallow.role: Villager, mother of a resurrected child
known_facts: Her son died of fever and was returned to her by the Communion.
He is alive and healthy, but subtly not himself -- quieter, oddly formal, afraid of the dark in a way he never was before.
mira_hallow.notes: Embodies the 'same person' theme. Recurring NPC -- let the change in her son deepen slowly across sessions rather than revealing it all at once.

toby_reyes.name: Toby Reyes
known_facts: Woke up ten years older than he went to sleep, with no memory of the years taken.
The years were spent resurrecting a stranger's child in a neighboring village -- he never consented and was never told beforehand.
toby_reyes.notes: The clearest embodiment of 'who gets to decide it was worth it.' He does not see himself as part of a noble sacrifice -- he calls it theft.

aldric_voss.name: Brother Aldric Voss
known_facts: Believes dissent from the Communion's mission is a form of cruelty toward the suffering.
Personally oversees involuntary sacrifices and considers mercy toward objectors to be weakness.
aldric_voss.notes: Primary recurring antagonist below Seraphine herself. Represents zealotry rather than sincerity -- a useful contrast with Elian Thorn.

rowan_ashcombe.name: Inquisitor Rowan Ashcombe
known_facts: Assigned by the Crown to quietly investigate the Communion's growing political influence.
Suspicious of the party at first, but a potential ally once the Communion's methods become undeniable.
rowan_ashcombe.notes: Good source of Crown-facing quests and a route into Caldrenne's political layer.

wren_calder.name: Wren Calder
known_facts: A former Communion believer who left after learning what an involuntary sacrifice actually looked like up close.
Does not oppose the idea of miracles -- only the Communion's willingness to take without consent.
wren_calder.notes: Represents the nuanced middle position: pro-miracle, anti-Seraphine's-methods. Useful for keeping the debate from becoming one-sided.

nessa_doyle.name: Archivist Nessa Doyle
known_facts: Knows why the Hollow Saint was deliberately erased from religious record.
Suspects the Saint has intentions of its own, separate from whoever is trying to resurrect it.
nessa_doyle.notes: Primary lore-delivery NPC for the late-game reveal about the Saint's true nature. Withhold her full knowledge until Act 4.
